changelog:
- Cookie Consent Banner Neutralizer: Added web-wide cosmetic blocking and auto-dismissal for cookie prompts across search engines (especially Ecosia search results, Google, OneTrust, Cookiebot, etc.).
- Start Page Cleanup: Removed middle Live Pulse card and bottom footer buttons for a clean, distraction-free home screen.
- Live Pulse & Ghost Mode Fix: Removed lightning logo from Live Pulse button and resolved JS ReferenceError; added tactile haptic feel and instant status toast for Ghost Mode.
- Custom Shortcuts & Official Logos: Full shortcut management with official SVG brand logos (Google, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit, Wikipedia, Spotify, GitHub, Netflix, Amazon), pin/unpin prioritization, and custom URL adding.
- Direct Theme Upload: Added direct user image/theme upload with persistent local storage.
- Unboxed About Page: Redesigned fokk://about into a sleek, borderless, ultra-professional modern editorial layout.
- Search Engine Logos: Upgraded search engine selector dialog to display authentic full-color logos for Ecosia, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Google, and Startpage.
- AI Slop Filter: Restored visible AI Overviews & Slop Filter toggle in Defense & Privacy menu.
